intended_object: The universal-property lift for the localization of an additive commutative monoid A away from an element x. Given a localization map F : A →+ B away from x and an additive monoid map g : A →+ C with g x an additive unit, it is the unique induced map B →+ C, sending F y − n•F x to g y − n•g x. This comes from the docstring and the multiplicative analogue just above it in the file.
explanation:
The body applies the general localization lift `AddSubmonoid.LocalizationMap.lift` to the localization at `multiples x`. To do so it must show that g sends every element of `multiples x` to an additive unit. It does this by writing such an element as n • x, so that g(n • x) = n • g x, which is the image of the unit g x under the additive monoid map `nsmulAddMonoidHom n`, and therefore a unit. This is exactly the standard lift out of a localization away from an element, given that g x is invertible. The companion lemmas `lift_eq` and `lift_comp` confirm that it is the map with F.lift ∘ F = g.

This is the hand-written additive version of `Submonoid.LocalizationMap.AwayMap.lift`, which is the same construction in multiplicative notation, not a different object. It is stated for arbitrary additive commutative monoids, which is the natural generality, so it is not too narrow.
